_comment: Canonical MCP server definitions. Edit this file, then run scripts/render_settings.py (renders shared/mcp/servers.json and codex/config.toml) and after it scripts/render-mcp.sh (reads servers.json for ~/.claude.json, this file for OpenCode and Gemini). Schema: each server has either a `url` + `transport` (for remote HTTP/SSE servers) OR a `command` + `args` (for local stdio servers). Optional: `description`, `headers`, `env`, `enabled`.

linear.description: Linear — issues, projects, comments. OAuth 2.1 (interactive on first use).
